name: Maternity Benefits
text: To the extent applicable, the Employee shall be entitled to maternity benefits in accordance with Chapter VI of the Code on Social Security, 2020, including paid maternity leave, nursing breaks, and protection against dismissal during the statutory maternity period. The Employer shall not require any work of a nature that is arduous or likely to interfere with pregnancy or the normal development of the foetus during the periods specified under the Act. Nothing in this Agreement shall reduce any benefit to which the Employee is statutorily entitled.

legal_basis.note: Right to payment of maternity benefit — maximum period of twenty-six weeks
Maternity benefit, including protection against dismissal during the maternity period

invalid_if: Agreement purports to waive statutory maternity entitlements
title: Maternity Benefits
authoring_note: LABOUR CODES, 21 NOVEMBER 2025. The four labour Codes were brought into force on 21 November 2025, repealing the 29 central labour statutes this clause previously cited. The 26-week entitlement carries across to CSS s.60. The section replacing the repealed Maternity Benefit Act s.12 (dismissal during maternity absence is void) was not individually verified, so Chapter VI is cited instead of a guessed section. The advocate should pin it, and confirm the creche threshold at s.67.
